gen-dafont-starborn-gf-mozilla-headline: Starborn drifts across the top with wide gaps between its letters and a dense, dark band of lowercase. And Mozilla Headline follows in a friendly plain sans, its big-bodied letters keeping a long paragraph easy to settle into.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-mozilla-text: Dreamy spacing defines Starborn, its letters floating apart above a thick, dark line of lowercase. And Mozilla Text brings the weight back down to earth, tall bodies and flared terminals making the pair feel grounded.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-nata-sans: Starry and spaced out, then suddenly drawn tight. Nata Sans takes over with open-mouthed curves and a technical-pen steadiness, so a long passage moves along smoothly beneath the heading's low, stem-thin crossbars.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-nokora: Nokora is a sans-serif with a wide-open s that never tightens, and it carries the same dark lowercase stripe as the heading. But Starborn's gaps between letters are what make the pair memorable, a dreamy drift above a grounded line.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Starborn floats in with ethereal gaps between its letters and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase. Noto Kufi Arabic brings the pair down to earth with an open gap in the c, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans: Spacious and starry up top. And Noto Sans sits beneath it as a plain sans, its lowercase filling most of the letter height, so the two feel like night sky meeting daylight.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Starborn does dreamy best, scattering its letters across wide gaps, while the body font does tidy best, with tall, full c, s and z.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Dreamy gaps run between Starborn's letters, above a thick, dark band of lowercase that holds each line together. Size the plain sans body up a little.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-anatoli: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs has terminal tips that point outward and an x-height close to cap height. Starborn above it stays ethereal, so Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs can be left at a modest size.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Ethereal is Starborn's whole manner, with wide gaps between letters and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase. Noto Sans Arabic does the opposite job, a plain sans with wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height.
